[del]$\text{(Wint}>1)$[/del] $\Theta t = \frac{1}{1-e^{-\frac{1}{2}t}} - \frac{1}{t} - \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{12t} - \frac{1}{720t^3} + \frac{1}{30240t^5} - \frac{1}{1209600t^7} + \dots$

$\beta = \frac{1}{1-e^{-\frac{1}{2}t}} - \frac{1}{t} - \frac{1}{2}$

So that the $(N+1)^{\text{th}}$ term divided by the $N^{\text{th}}$ is $\frac{2N-1}{2} t^{-2}$

$= - (2N-1) (\frac{1}{2t})^2$
